hero.headline: Burglars skip homes that look lived-in. Kevin makes yours one of them.
hero.lede: For families at work, travellers, second-home owners and anyone living alone: one Swiss-made device plays light, moving shadows and everyday sounds by the window — no camera, no microphone, and it keeps running when Wi-Fi is jammed.
hero.away_body: Light, shadow and sound vary automatically — never the same evening twice.
hero.privacy_body: Simulations run on the device. Nothing is streamed or shared.
hero.checkout_body: Across the EU, Switzerland, Norway and Iceland.

problem.heading: An empty-looking home is the easiest target on the street.
problem.subheading: Dark windows, one lamp on a timer, silence in the hallway — that is what an opportunist checks in seconds, from the pavement. Kevin gives them the opposite: a home that looks and sounds lived-in, whether you are at work, on holiday, or the only one at home tonight.
problem.tile_1_body: Moving human silhouettes on the wall or ceiling, visible through the curtains — the sign of life a burglar looks for before choosing a house.
problem.tile_2_title: The sound of a normal evening
problem.tile_2_body: Conversation, a TV, cooking, a dog that barks at the doorbell — played from the device, so even up close someone is clearly home.
problem.tile_3_body: The same lamp at the same time every night reads as automation. Kevin varies light, shadow and sound for up to four weeks without repeating.
problem.tile_4_title: The layer your alarm doesn't have
problem.tile_4_body: An alarm reacts after the door is tested. Kevin works before: from the street the house looks occupied, so the attempt never starts. Keep your alarm — put prevention in front of it.

mechanism.heading: Light. Shadow. Sound.
mechanism.subheading: A burglar judges a home in seconds — by its light, its movement, its sound. Kevin delivers all three from one device, so your home looks lived-in from the street to the doorstep, and they move on to an easier target.
mechanism.phase_1_body: Warm light shifts like real lamps and a flickering TV — never the rigid on-off of a cheap timer.
mechanism.phase_2_body: Moving silhouettes pass behind the curtains — exactly what a burglar checks before choosing a target.
mechanism.phase_3_body: Voices, a TV, cooking and a dog at the doorbell play from the device — so even up close, someone is clearly home.

jammer.heading: Jammers blind cameras. Kevin keeps playing.
jammer.subheading: Cheap jamming devices cut cameras and app alarms off the network. Kevin plays every simulation from its own storage — no cloud, no signal, no gap.
jammer.col_1_body: Streams stop, alerts never send. A jammed camera protects no one — it just records nothing.
jammer.col_2_body: Light, shadow and sound continue from local storage — the house never skips a beat.

app.heading: Set it once. It runs itself.
app.subheading: Weekly schedules, geofencing that switches Kevin on when you leave, and every property in one app — so protection never depends on remembering.
app.tile_1_body: Set weekends, holidays or your daily routine once. Kevin follows the plan while you get on with life.
app.tile_2_body: Leave the house and Kevin starts on its own when your phone leaves the area — no taps, no reminders.
app.tile_3_body: Record dinner, the kids, the dog. Kevin mixes your recordings with its own scenes, so your home sounds like your home.
app.tile_4_body: A second home, a holiday flat, the office: add a Kevin to each and manage them all from your phone.
app.ui_row_4: Away mode — starts when you leave

authority.heading: Three jobs. One quiet device.
authority.subheading: Kevin exists for the hours a home is honestly empty — and for the nights someone is home alone.
authority.reason_1_body: Burglars pick easy, empty targets. A home that glows, moves and speaks gets skipped.
authority.reason_2_body: Chalets, holiday flats and boats stay believably lived-in between your visits.
authority.reason_3_body: For a parent living alone or a daughter in her first flat: voices, movement and a dog — so the house never looks like an easy target.
authority.quote: The small Kevin.3 is unrivalled in that it's an easy-to-use, all-in-one solution that delivers a truly spectacular show.

audience.heading: Every home is sometimes empty.
audience.subheading: Kevin moves in wherever life moves out — for an evening, a season or a semester.
